name: Bark Beetle Disturbance and Hiking Well-Being (slider)
description:
Faithful replication of Kortmann et al. (2022), Forests 13:1954, a survey of how much bark-beetle-killed forest hikers in national parks accept. Participants give age, gender, education, occupation and national-park visits, answer the 20-item 2-MEV environmental-values scale (5 = fully agree … 1 = strongly disagree), pick an Inclusion of Nature in Self diagram (A–G), and then move a slider under a photomontage of Bavarian Forest National Park (from dead to living trees) to where their well-being on a hike would be highest. The share of living and dead trees (0–100%) is recorded. In the original study (1,008 respondents) the median preferred share of dead trees was 26%.

Differences from the original study: (1) the slider starts in the middle and must be moved (the paper does not report the start position); (2) the Inclusion of Nature in Self circles are redrawn after Schultz (2001); (3) age is entered as a number; (4) gender option wording was written for this template; (5) the photomontage is cut from Figure 1 of the paper without its slider bar.

Image: photomontage from Kortmann et al. (2022), Figure 1 (CC BY 4.0). Used with credit for research; the template is removed if the authors object.
author: Kortmann, Angelstam, Mayer, Leibl, Reichert, Thorn & Thorn

elements.description: Inclusion of Nature in Self (INS): seven pairs of circles A–G from separate (1) to fully overlapping (7).

elements.name: wellbeing_position
elements.title: Imagine you are hiking through a forested national park. The hiking trail crosses areas with different proportions of living and dead trees (0–100%). Please move the slider to the position at which your personal well-being would be the highest.
elements.description: One photomontage of the Bavarian Forest National Park running from entirely beetle-killed forest (left) to entirely intact forest (right), with a slider underneath. Value: {living_trees_percent, dead_trees_percent} (integers 0–100, slider position from the left = % living trees). Paper: median 26% / mean 30% dead trees; 41% of respondents chose < 20% dead, 77% < 50% dead.

        "value": 1,
        "text": "1 strongly disagree"
       }
      ]
     }
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "ins",
    "title": "Connection with nature",
    "elements": [
     {
      "type": "radiogroup",
      "name": "inclusion_of_nature",
      "title": "Please rate how connected you feel to nature.",
      "isRequired": true,
      "description": "Inclusion of Nature in Self (INS): seven pairs of circles A–G from separate (1) to fully overlapping (7).",
      "choices": [
       {
        "value": 1,
        "text": "A — separate"
       },
       {
        "value": 2,
        "text": "B"
       },
       {
        "value": 3,
        "text": "C"
       },
       {
        "value": 4,
        "text": "D"
       },
       {
        "value": 5,
        "text": "E"
       },
       {
        "value": 6,
        "text": "F"
       },
       {
        "value": 7,
        "text": "G — fully overlapping"
       }
      ]
     }
    ]
   },
   {
    "name": "slider",
    "elements": [
     {
      "type": "custom",
      "name": "wellbeing_position",
      "title": "Imagine you are hiking through a forested national park. The hiking trail crosses areas with different proportions of living and dead trees (0–100%). Please move the slider to the position at which your personal well-being would be the highest.",
      "isRequired": true,
      "description": "One photomontage of the Bavarian Forest National Park running from entirely beetle-killed forest (left) to entirely intact forest (right), with a slider underneath. Value: {living_trees_percent, dead_trees_percent} (integers 0–100, slider position from the left = % living trees). Paper: median 26% / mean 30% dead trees; 41% of respondents chose < 20% dead, 77% < 50% dead.",
      "trials": [
       {
        "id": "gradient",
        "file": "bark_beetle_gradient.jpg"
       }
      ]
     }
    ]
   }
  ]
 }
}
</script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#eff1ec;--card:#fff;--ink:#1f2420;--muted:#5b6359;--accent:#2f6a3f;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d5dbd2;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 0 10px}
p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.q{margin-top:18px}.q:first-child{margin-top:0}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}.on{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card)}
input[type=text],input[type=number]{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:100%;max-width:360px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px}
.seg label{display:block;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.seg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-height:42px;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15}
.seg input:checked+span{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.seg input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.ins{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr));gap:8px}
.ins label{display:block;cursor:pointer;position:relative;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:6px;text-align:center;background:#fff}
.ins input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.ins label:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent)}
.ins label:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.ins svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}.ins b{display:block;font-size:.95rem}
.pic{border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;overflow:hidden;background:#ddd}.pic img{width:100%;display:block}
.sl{position:relative;padding:10px 0 4px}
input[type=range]{width:100%;margin:0;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;height:14px;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a9aba6,#2f6a3f);outline-offset:4px}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:30px;height:38px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;border:2px solid #555;cursor:pointer}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{width:28px;height:36px;border-radius:6px;background:#fff;border:2px solid #555;cursor:pointer}
input[type=range].untouched::-webkit-slider-thumb{opacity:.55}
.ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Photomontage: Kortmann et al. (2022), Forests 13:1954, Figure 1, doi:10.3390/f13111954 (CC BY 4.0; edited photograph of the Bavarian Forest National Park). Circle diagrams redrawn after Schultz (2001). Used with credit for research; removed if the authors object.</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var KEY='barkbeetle2022:';
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, files={}, done={}, SPEC=null, TRIAL=null, MEV=[], ABOUT=['age','gender','education','occupation','np_visited','np_which'];
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e){e.textContent=m||'';e.style.visibility='visible';}}
  function hideErr(){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.style.visibility='hidden';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function load(k){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY+k));}catch(e){return null;}}
  function save(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY+k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
  function q(n){return Q[n]||{};}
  function page(html,btn,cb){
    app.innerHTML=html+'<div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="btn" id="go">'+esc(btn||'Continue')+'</button></div><div class="err"></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=cb;app.onchange=hideErr;app.oninput=hideErr;
  }
  function saveAll(l,b,cb){Promise.all(l.map(function(a){return SPSite.answer(a[0],a[1]);})).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}cb();});}
  function next(){
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    if(!done.intro)return intro();
    if(!done.about)return about();
    if(!done.mev)return mev();
    if(!done.ins)return ins();
    if(!done.slider)return slider();
    finish();
  }
  function intro(){
    if(!files[TRIAL.file]){app.innerHTML='<h1>Picture missing</h1><p>Media folder landscape must hold bark_beetle_gradient.jpg.</p>';return;}
    page('<h1>Forests, nature and well-being</h1><p>This short survey asks about your attitudes towards nature and about forests in national parks. At the end you will see a forest landscape and choose, with a slider, where you would feel best on a hike.</p><p>It takes about 10 minutes. Your answers are anonymous.</p>'+
      '<div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(q('consent').title)+'</label></div>','Start',function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Please confirm to continue.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll([['consent',true]],b,function(){done.intro=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function about(){
    var h=ABOUT.map(function(n){var d=q(n);var t='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(d.title)+(d.isRequired?'':' <span class="on">(optional)</span>')+'</b>';
      if(d.type==='text')t+='<input type="'+(d.inputType==='number'?'number':'text')+'" name="'+n+'"'+(d.inputType==='number'?' min="18" max="110" inputmode="numeric"':'')+'>';
      else t+=d.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="'+n+'" value="'+c.value+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');
      return t+'</div>';}).join('');
    page('<h1>About you</h1><div class="card">'+h+'</div>','Continue',function(){
      var l=[];for(var i=0;i<ABOUT.length;i++){var n=ABOUT[i],d=q(n),v;
        if(d.type==='text'){var s=app.querySelector('input[name="'+n+'"]').value.trim();if(d.inputType==='number'){v=s===''?undefined:Number(s);if(v!==undefined&&(!(v>=18&&v<=110)||v%1))return err('Please enter your age in whole years (18 or older).');}else v=s||undefined;}
        else{var x=app.querySelector('input[name="'+n+'"]:checked');v=x?Number(x.value):undefined;}
        if(v===undefined){if(d.isRequired)return err('Please answer: '+d.title);continue;}l.push([n,v]);}
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll(l,b,function(){done.about=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function mev(){
    var h=MEV.map(function(n,k){var d=q(n);return '<div class="q"><b>'+(k+1)+'. '+esc(d.title)+'</b><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="'+esc(d.title)+'">'+d.choices.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.value-b.value;}).map(function(c){return '<label><input type="radio" name="'+n+'" value="'+c.value+'"><span>'+esc(c.text)+'</span></label>';}).join('')+'</div></div>';}).join('');
    page('<h1>Attitudes towards nature</h1><div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink)">Please rate the following statements from 5 (fully agree) to 4 (rather agree), 3 (neither/undecided), 2 (rather disagree) to 1 (strongly disagree).</p>'+h+'</div>','Continue',function(){
      var l=[];for(var i=0;i<MEV.length;i++){var x=app.querySelector('input[name="'+MEV[i]+'"]:checked');if(!x)return err('Please answer statement '+(i+1)+'.');l.push([MEV[i],Number(x.value)]);}
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll(l,b,function(){done.mev=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function circles(k){
    var gap=[110,92,76,60,40,22,0][k],cx1=70-gap/2,cx2=70+gap/2,r=34;
    if(k===6)return '<svg viewBox="0 0 140 80" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="70" cy="40" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="70" cy="40" r="'+(r-2)+'" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><text x="70" y="44" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Self Nature</text></svg>';
    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 140 80" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="'+cx1+'" cy="40" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/><circle cx="'+cx2+'" cy="40" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2.5"/><text x="'+(cx1-(gap>40?0:12))+'" y="44" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Self</text><text x="'+(cx2+(gap>40?0:12))+'" y="44" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Nature</text></svg>';
  }
  function ins(){
    var d=q('inclusion_of_nature');
    var h='<div class="ins" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Connection with nature">'+'ABCDEFG'.split('').map(function(L,k){return '<label><input type="radio" name="ins" value="'+(k+1)+'">'+circles(k)+'<b>'+L+'</b></label>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    page('<h1>Connection with nature</h1><div class="card"><div class="q"><b>'+esc(d.title)+'</b><p>Choose the picture that best describes your relationship with nature: from A (self and nature separate) to G (self and nature fully overlapping).</p>'+h+'</div></div>','Continue',function(){
      var x=app.querySelector('input[name=ins]:checked');if(!x)return err('Please choose one picture (A–G).');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;saveAll([['inclusion_of_nature',Number(x.value)]],b,function(){done.ins=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function slider(){
    var f=files[TRIAL.file],touched=false;
    page('<div class="card"><p style="color:var(--ink);font-weight:600">'+esc(q('wellbeing_position').title)+'</p><div class="pic"><img alt="Forest landscape from entirely beetle-killed (left) to entirely intact (right)" src="'+esc(f.url)+'"></div><div class="sl"><input type="range" id="r" class="untouched" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50" aria-label="Position in the landscape"></div><div class="ends"><span>← more dead trees</span><span>more living trees →</span></div></div>','Finish',function(){
      if(!touched)return err('Please move the slider to the position where your well-being would be highest.');
      var v=Number(document.getElementById('r').value),b=this;b.disabled=true;
      SPSite.answer('wellbeing_position',{living_trees_percent:v,dead_trees_percent:100-v},{key:TRIAL.id,shown:[f.name]}).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){b.disabled=false;return err(r.error);}done.slider=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
    var r=document.getElementById('r');function t(){touched=true;r.classList.remove('untouched');}
    r.addEventListener('input',t);r.addEventListener('change',t);
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p>The landscape was an edited photograph of the Bavarian Forest National Park, running from entirely beetle-killed forest on the left to intact forest on the right. In the original survey of 1008 German residents, the chosen position corresponded to a median of 26% and a mean of 30% dead trees; 41% of people chose fewer than 20% dead trees and 77% fewer than 50%. People who felt more connected with nature and valued preservation preferred more living trees, while people who had already visited a national park with bark beetle outbreaks were more accepting of dead trees.</p><p style="font-size:.82rem">Kortmann, M., Angelstam, P., Mayer, M., Leibl, F., Reichert, J., Thorn, C., & Thorn, S. (2022). Disturbance Severity and Human–Nature Relationships: A New Approach to Analyze People’s Well-Being along a Bark Beetle Infestation Gradient. Forests 13:1954, doi:10.3390/f13111954.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');var m=r.missing||[];setTimeout(function(){m.forEach(function(x){if(x==='consent')done.intro=false;else if(x==='wellbeing_position')done.slider=false;else if(x==='inclusion_of_nature')done.ins=false;else if(/^mev/.test(x))done.mev=false;else done.about=false;});save('d',done);next();},1800);}
      else{var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    try{SPEC=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sp-scheme').textContent).survey;}catch(e){SPEC={pages:[]};}
    SPEC.pages.forEach(function(p){p.elements.forEach(function(e){var g=SPSite.getQuestion(e.name)||{};Q[e.name]={type:e.type,inputType:e.inputType,title:g.title||e.title,isRequired:e.isRequired,choices:(g.choices&&g.choices.length)?g.choices:e.choices};if(/^mev\d+$/.test(e.name))MEV.push(e.name);if(e.name==='wellbeing_position')TRIAL=e.trials[0];});});
    (SPSite.getMedia('landscape')||[]).forEach(function(f){files[f.name]=f;});
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};done=load('d')||{};
    done.intro=a.consent===true;
    done.about=['age','gender','education','np_visited'].every(function(n){return a[n]!=null;});
    done.mev=MEV.every(function(n){return a[n]!=null;});
    done.ins=a.inclusion_of_nature!=null;
    done.slider=!!(a.wellbeing_position&&((a.wellbeing_position.trials||[]).length||a.wellbeing_position.living_trees_percent!=null));
    next();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Faithful replication of Kortmann et al. (2022), Forests 13:1954: move a slider along a photomontage of a bark-beetle-affected forest to the point where your well-being on a hike would be highest, after the 2-MEV environmental values scale and the Inclusion of Nature in Self question.

paper.title: Disturbance Severity and Human–Nature Relationships: A New Approach to Analyze People’s Well-Being along a Bark Beetle Infestation Gradient
